news.title: 创始人CEO创业洞察：为何战略契合胜过PMF
news.snippet: 创始人CEO认为战略契合度比Product-Market Fit对初创企业长期成功更为关键。
news.raw_snippet: # Founder-CEO Startup Intelligence: Why Strategic Fit Beats Product-Market Fit. Forbes contributors publish independent expert analyses and insights. New research highlights 'Founder-CEO Startup Intelligence' as the core of entrepreneurial success, emphasizing the discovery of 'Strategic Fit.' This critical skill involves identifying emerging trends and aligning the right opportunity, market, competitive position, and sales strategy. In an era where AI automates many startup tasks, mastering Strategic Fit—discovering the optimal market alignment faster than competitors—is becoming the paramount competitive advantage for founders aiming to build billion-dollar enterprises. Yet both reveal the same first layer of growth entrepreneurship: Founder-CEO Startup Intelligence — the ability to identify an emerging opportunity and discover Strategic Fit that can beat competitors. This framework is grounded in my research on billion-dollar entrepreneurs — founders who started ventures and remained in leadership until those ventures exceeded $1 billion in both sales and valuation. Founder-CEO Startup Intelligence is the ability to discover this fit faster and more effectively than others in emerging trends.

news.title: AI可以撰写食谱，但只有人类能品尝食物
news.snippet: 人工智能虽能生成内容，但人类独特体验、判断力和创造力仍不可替代。
news.raw_snippet: #### Artificial Intelligence. # AI may write the recipe, but only we can taste the food. by Shelley Zalis  Published July 2, 2026 in Artificial Intelligence • 4 min read • Audio availableAudio available. ### AI can optimize processes, but true leadership requires human judgment, says Shelley Zalis. That distinction will define the next era of leadership. As AI reshapes work, it will not do so evenly: gaps in access, skills, and leadership will widen. The future of work will not just be defined by how we use AI, but by who gets to shape it. The differentiator is not access to AI, but how intelligently it is applied. This is what defines AIQ: the intelligent application of artificial intelligence – the ability to combine machine intelligence with human judgment to drive better outcomes. * **Invest in workforce AI fluency.** The greatest risk is not AI itself, but a workforce that does not know how to use it effectively.

news.raw_snippet: A marine layer hung over Oakland on Wednesday, the last day of testimony in the liability phase of Elon Musk's lawsuit against artificial intelligence company OpenAI and its CEO and president -- Sam Altman and Greg Brockman, respectively. The trial centers on the 2015 birth of ChatGPT maker OpenAI as a nonprofit startup primarily funded by Musk before evolving into a capitalistic venture now valued at $852 billion. The civil lawsuit accuses Altman, OpenAI's CEO, of double-crossing Musk by straying from the company's founding mission to be an altruistic steward of the technology. *   May 12, 2026, 4:21 PM GMT Sam Altman takes the stand in trial that could determine OpenAI's future. ## Sam Altman takes the stand in trial that could determine OpenAI's future.
